title: South Korea — Candlelight Protests 2016-17
description: Protestas pacíficas con velas contra presidenta Park Geun-hye. Record Guinness: 2M personas. Terminó con impeachment exitoso. Ejemplo de cascada de consenso exitosa.
data_notes: P represents consensus_cascade_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: 1 - std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Consensus cascade index: P rises as consensus builds toward impeachment, then declines as issue resolves. Observation operator H: 1 - std(opinion_dimension) (higher consensus = lower variance).
